name: Play Too Much Beijing Circle Prince Come to the Door to Name Points (2024)
original_name: 玩过火，京圈太子爷上门要名分
overview:
On the wedding night, her husband eloped abroad with her best friend. Jiang Ci You wiped away her tears, got drunk at the bar, and met the handsome man. Later, she found out that he was the dreaded prince of the Beijing circle.

(Source: Chinese = Douban || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wan Dan! Wo Yang De Xiao Bai Lian Shi Jing Quan Tai Zi Ye" (完蛋！我养的小白脸是京圈太子爷) by La Bi Xiao Nian (蜡笔小年).
